title: DSV Cormorant, dive 214
blurb: Five documents about a fictional deep-submergence incident: the preliminary report, the engineering teardown, the review board's findings, the pilot's log, and the maintenance record. The vessel is invented, so anything specific about it can only have come from these pages — but submersibles are real, so the model has plenty to say from memory. Watch which is which.
questions: Why did the Cormorant lose power on dive 214?
How late was the maintenance window moved, and why does that matter?
Did the crew make a mistake?
How deep can a crewed submersible go, and what happened to Cormorant at depth?
Who was aboard, and was anyone hurt?
What should change so this does not happen again?
